text:
Casey: quick UX check  thresholds row — two debates: keep unit controls inline as a tiny dropdown, or a two-state micro-toggle (short / verbose)? also the preview chips collapse at narrow widths and sometimes overlap the rule name. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/ux/preview-collapse.png

Jun: prefer dropdown for discoverability, but we can visually render compact `5m` and expose full wording to ATs via aria-describedby. avoids extra weight.

Marta: toggle is nice for dense lists. if we use toggle, make sure toggling updates an offscreen verbose label like `per 5 minutes` so SRs read it. Also add a tiny info icon that explains units.

Isaac: accessibility: ensure numeric input has accessible spin controls and aria-valuemin/max/step. keyboard order should be: value -> unit control -> suppression toggle -> preview expand -> save. currently tab skips the suppression toggle on VoiceOver.

a11y-bot: Contrast scan: muted-chip text #6B6B6B on #FFF = 3.9 (fails AA 14px). Recommendations: neutral-800 (#333333) or semibold 600 at 14px. Add focus-visible outline on pills and an aria-live polite region for suppression changes: "Suppression enabled  2 channels muted".

Casey: mobile suggestion: no horizontal scroller for pills. show first row + a "+N more" control that expands to a stacked list with role:list and aria-roledescription='notification channels'. button should have aria-expanded and aria-controls.

Jun: preview should surface fallbacks. show `Primary: Slack (latency) • Fallback: Email (on error)` with a tooltip explaining trigger conditions. Hidden fallbacks confuse SRE flow.

Marta: copy nit: helper reads `when error rate > 2%`. propose `When error rate exceeds 2% (p95, over 5 minutes)` or let percentile be explicit. change preview header to `Previewing 3 channels — 1 muted`.

Isaac: implementation note: keep muted chips in DOM but dim them and add aria-label like `PagerDuty — muted`. announce toggles via aria-live. instrument expand/collapse of +N for telemetry.

Casey: action items: Jun mock both dropdown + toggle with sr-only verbose text, Marta update microcopy in Figma, Isaac to write a11y acceptance criteria and tab-order tests, I'll pick accessible token for muted chip color. target: next design huddle Wednesday. :thumbsup:
